rules.name: Standard Data Transmission Rate
rules.source_quote: The data stream shall be transmitted by the SV on the L1 and L2 channels at a rate of 50 bps.
rules.test_hint: Generate frames with a data rate different from 50 bps to test if the network correctly identifies the deviation.

rules.name: Alternative Data Transmission Rate with FEC
rules.source_quote: In addition, upon ground command, the data stream shall be transmitted by the Block IIR -M SV on the L2 CM channel at a rate of 25 bps using FEC encoding resulting in 50 sps.
rules.test_hint: Send frames with a data rate different from 25 bps when FEC is applied to test network response.

rules.name: Subframe Bit Length
rules.source_quote: As shown in Figure 20 -1, the message structure shall utilize a basic format of a 1500 bit long frame made up of five subframes, each subframe being 300 bits long.
rules.test_hint: Create frames with subframes longer or shorter than 300 bits to test if the network detects the anomaly.

rules.name: Frame Composition

constraint.value: Each frame consists of five subframes, each 300 bits long.

rules.source_quote: As shown in Figure 20 -1, the message structure shall utilize a basic format of a 1500 bit long frame made up of five subframes, each subframe being 300 bits long.
rules.test_hint: Send frames that do not consist of exactly five subframes to test network handling of incorrect frame composition.

rules.name: Word Order in Subframe

constraint.value: Each subframe starts with a TLM word followed by a HOW, then eight data words.

rules.source_quote: Each subframe and/or page of a subframe shall contain a telemetry (TLM) word and a handover word (HOW), both generated by the SV, and shall start with the TLM/HOW pair.
rules.test_hint: Create subframes where the TLM or HOW words are not in the correct order to test network validation of word order.

rules.name: Word Parity

constraint.value: Each word in each frame shall contain parity.

rules.source_quote: Each word in each frame shall contain parity (reference Section 20.3.5).
rules.test_hint: Send frames with words that lack parity to test if the network correctly identifies parity errors.

rules.name: Data Flow Direction
rules.source_quote: DIRECTION OF DATA FLOW FROM SV MSB FIRST
rules.test_hint: A fuzzer could send frames with LSB first to test if the network correctly identifies and handles this violation.

rules.name: TLM Word Length
rules.source_quote: Each TLM word is 30 bits long, occurs every six seconds in the data frame, and is the first word in each subframe/page.
rules.test_hint: A fuzzer could send frames with TLM words that are not 30 bits long to test if the network detects and handles this discrepancy.

rules.name: TLM Word Timing
rules.source_quote: Each TLM word is 30 bits long, occurs every six seconds in the data frame, and is the first word in each subframe/page.
rules.test_hint: A fuzzer could send TLM words at intervals other than six seconds to test the network's response to timing violations.

rules.name: Parity Bits
rules.test_hint: A fuzzer could alter the number of parity bits to test if the network correctly identifies and handles frames with incorrect parity bit counts.

rules.name: Noninformation Bearing Bits
rules.source_quote: t = 2 NONINFORMATION BEARING BITS USED FOR PARITY COMPUTATION
rules.test_hint: A fuzzer could send frames with a different number of noninformation bearing bits to test if the network detects and handles this violation.
